Madhya Pradesh Waqf Board Reforms After Amendment

The Indian state of Madhya Pradesh has reconstituted its Waqf Board for the first time after a law amendment, including two Hindu members in the board. This move is part of efforts to reform the Waqf system, which manages properties and funds related to Islamic endowments. The reforms aim to address concerns over the management and distribution of these assets. The decision has sparked debate among stakeholders, with some arguing that it will improve the efficiency of the Waqf system, while others have expressed concerns about the potential impact on minority communities.
